purpose: Render an ordered, status-aware message thread for consumer-owned conversations without owning persistence, streaming transport, or model policy.
useWhen: messages need stable author, timestamp, role, and status anatomy
a response should be read together with optional actions or tool results
avoidWhen: the library would need to manage conversation history or streaming transport
accessibility: Uses an ordered list and labelled message region so reading order remains explicit.
Exposes author, timestamp, role, and pending or error state as text in addition to icon treatment.
responsive: Wraps message content inside a bounded scroll owner.
Allows message actions and metadata to wrap without changing message order.
motion: Uses shared transitions for message surface feedback.
Does not require token streaming or animated typing to communicate content.

api.name: emptyMessage
api.description: Configures empty message for Conversation Thread.

api.name: aria-label
api.description: Accessible label relationship for the rendered element.
